penalties_range: Administrative fines up to NIS 320,000 per violation (higher if aggravated / per-data-subject based); criminal penalties
deceased_data: No express rule; commentators say the dead have no privacy rights under the Law; courts recognized a separate publicity right surviving death 25+ years (Dali, 2016) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Governed by separate Genetic Information Law 5761-2000: testing needs informed consent/authorization; genetic data also sensitive under the Privacy Law
notes: Amendment 13 effective 2025-08-14: PPA fining powers, DPO duty, broader definitions
